required_fixes: Re-implement C2 non-uniform decay test per prereg: one-way ANOVA on lag-1..6 ACF values or valid non-uniformity test with independent observations. Current result.json c2_anova_p=0.0 is from ad-hoc chi2 on variance/expected_var (analyze_v2.py:f_stat=acf_var/expected_var, p=1-chi2.cdf), not ANOVA. Do not report p=0.0 as ANOVA.

Re-implement C3 inter-event multimodality per prereg using actual Hartigan dip test (not max|ecdf-uniform| with permutation shuffle). Current hartigan_dip_test in analyze_v2.py computes dip as ecdf vs uniform CDF and bootstraps via permutation of data values, not sampling from unimodal null. Dip values ~0.39-0.42 and p=1.0 are artefacts. Use scipy or diptest reference implementation or acknowledge descriptive unimodality without p-value.

Correct baseline fidelity: spec.json/PREREG falsifier C1 requires B-SHUFFLE-ACTION (shuffle action labels preserving states). Producer executed B-SHUFFLE-STATE (shuffle url_after within sessions, analyze_v2.py:shuffle_states_within_sessions) and reported it as C1 test. For ACF on states, shuffling actions is degenerate (state sequence unchanged). Amend spec or report deviation explicitly; recompute B-SHUFFLE-ACTION if claim is action-conditioned, or rename hypothesis to state-sequence autocorrelation.

Repair or replace POS-DETERMINISTIC-SPA: synthetic 12-state stochastic SPA (raw_synthetic.json, N=5000, 12 states, determinism=0/48) yields lag1_acf=-0.0547, null_95=0.0247, fail per result.json controls.POS-DETERMINISTIC-SPA.pass=false. Temporal-order integer encoding destroys uniform-transition cycle structure. Positive control must be redesigned (e.g., synthetic SPA with strong lag-1 transition bias and monotonic encoding, or transition-count-based metric as in parent Bayesian DM) before pipeline can be claimed validated for timescale detection.

Resolve decision_rule inconsistency: spec.json falsifier says FALSIFIED if ANY of C1/C2/C3 fails, while decision_rule says SUPPORTS requires C1+C2+interaction and MIXED if some pass some fail. Outcome MIXED (C1 pass, C2 pass, C3 fail) satisfies both FALSIFIED and MIXED under frozen text. Freeze amendment needed to define precedence.

Report effective independent N=2 FSM types, not 5 variants. Vanillajs/react/svelte share 4-state pattern (acf_observed 0.4181 identical), vue/angular share 3-state pattern (0.4540 identical) but full URLs differ by domain prefix; they are isomorphic FSMs with same cycle logic (fragments '', '/active', '/completed'), not 5 independent replications. Bonferroni across 5 is conservative; per-FSM-type power is limited to 6 sessions.

Disclose encoding sensitivity and script artifact as primary validity bound: ACF computed on temporal-order integer encoding (analyze_v2.py:encode_states_temporal_order) is ordinal-arbitrary; magnitude 0.42 is not interpretable as dynamical strength beyond permutation rank. Observed autocorrelation is fully explained by scripted 7-step cycle (step Counter shows 6 sessions × ~13 NL steps following fixed fragment cycle) and lies within B-MARKOV-1 surrogate range (mean 0.349, 95th 0.547), consistent with first-order deterministic FSM. Do not interpret as natural Web timescale separation without real user sessions.

Implement missing baseline B-FREQUENCY empirically and NULL-RANDOM-WALK as specified random walk on state graph (result.json baselines.B_FREQUENCY has only note, B_MARKOV_1 mean/std reported but controls.NULL-RANDOM-WALK.pass=true is inferred from shuffled-state mean -0.034, not from actual random walk). Run as frozen or mark as not executed.

validity_findings.finding: ACF values depend on temporal-order integer mapping of categorical URLs (first-appearance encoding). Determinism 0.925 (4-state) / 1.0 (vue) and var 1.17/0.69 mean ACF magnitude is encoding-contingent. Permutation test against shuffled-state null (mean -0.0335, std 0.104, 95th 0.138) is valid for rank ordering, but absolute ACF 0.418-0.454 cannot be interpreted as effect size for dynamics or compared across encodings.

validity_findings.finding: Strong lag-1 autocorrelation is attributable to scripted 7-step automation cycle, not natural Web dynamics. NL transitions follow fixed hash-fragment cycle ('', '/active', '/completed') across 6 Playwright sessions, uniform pacing (inter_event_times mean 1.12s, std 0.40, median 0.91, range 0.71-1.84, dip ~0.41 artifact). Producer validity_notes correctly acknowledge this, but hypothesis framing as timescale separation (page-load vs session vs site) is not expressed in this environment.

validity_findings.finding: Positive control fails: synthetic 12-state stochastic SPA (raw_synthetic.json N=5000, 12 states, 50 sessions, seed 42) lag1_acf=-0.0547 does not exceed null-95 0.0247 (observed < median 0.00056). Pipeline using sample ACF on temporal encoding cannot detect known Markov structure with near-uniform transitions. This invalidates claim that pipeline is validated to detect timescale structure when present; it does not invalidate the positive TodoMVC lag-1 detection but bounds generalizability.

validity_findings.finding: C2 non-uniform decay test reported as c2_anova_p=0.0, c2_passes=true for all variants is not a one-way ANOVA on lag-1..6 ACF values as preregistered. Code computes f_stat=acf_var/expected_var where expected_var=mean(null_std^2)/MAX_LAG, p=1-chi2.cdf(f*(k-1),k-1). With k=6 ACF numbers, this yields p=0.0 regardless of structure. Descriptive non-uniformity is visually evident (4-state: 0.42,0.04,-0.24,-0.09,-0.04,-0.04) but statistical claim is not per frozen method.
validity_findings.evidence: result.json:metrics.variants.*.c2_anova_p=0.0; /tmp/opencode/analyze_v2.py run_variant_analysis c2_results section; spec.json:measurement_validity and prereg H2 ANOVA specification

validity_findings.finding: C3 Hartigan dip test is misimplemented. hartigan_dip_test computes dip as max|ecdf - uniform_cdf| on sorted inter-event times and bootstraps by permuting observed values, not by sampling uniform null. Reported dip ~0.391-0.417, p=1.0 on all variants is meaningless. Descriptive conclusion unimodal is plausible (mean 1.12s log-normal, range 0.71-1.84 from uniform Playwright waits), but inferential p-value is invalid.
validity_findings.evidence: result.json:metrics.inter_event_times vanillajs mean_s 1.117, std 0.402, observations[4] dip p=1.0; /tmp/opencode/analyze_v2.py:hartigan_dip_test

validity_findings.finding: FSM-type × lag interaction reported as p_interaction=0.9692 fail via permutation of labels on interaction variance (5k permutations), not two-way ANOVA FSM-type × lag as frozen. Result (no significant difference between 4-state mean 0.418 and 3-state mean 0.454 patterns) is descriptive and likely correct, but not per frozen interaction test.

80 NL transitions per variant (6 sessions each, 30 sessions total) meets frozen minimum 40 per FSM type for lag-6 ACF, but ACF at lags 2-6 is non-significant (p_raw 0.04-0.97) and underpowered. Effective independent replications =2 FSM types, not 5. Bonferroni 5-variant correction is conservative; using 2 would still pass (p_raw 0.0005*2=0.001 <0.01). Isomorphic structure within FSM type means 5-variant reporting overstates independence.
validity_findings.evidence: result.json:metrics.variants.*.n_nl=80, determinism_k2=0.925, observations[1] bit-identical within FSM type; provenance.json input_artifacts 5 nl_transitions files

validity_findings.finding: Timestamps are valid ISO8601, monotonic within sessions (verified: all sessions min diff 0.706-0.720s >0), resolution >1ms, 74 inter-event intervals per variant (6 sessions × ~13 steps minus session boundaries). Sufficient for inter-event analysis, but automation pacing (scripted waits + network latency) explains unimodal distribution, not operational timescales.

validity_findings.finding: URL+hash fragment is near-deterministic on TodoMVC (determinism 0.925-1.0, 3-4 states). State representation collapses full browser DOM/client state to URL, so action-conditioned dynamics beyond memory cannot be tested (consistent with parent negative BF -10 to -15 nats). ACF finding demonstrates script memory, not beyond-memory predictive structure required by C-WEB-DYNAMICS.
validity_findings.evidence: result.json:observations[7] determinism 92.5%, baselines.B_MARKOV_1 mean 0.349 within observed range; claim_state.json C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains HYPOTHESIS across 41 experiments

baseline_findings.expected: Within-session shuffled-action null: permute action labels, preserve state sequence, recompute ACF. Null ACF lag1 ~0.
baseline_findings.observed: NOT EXECUTED as specified. Producer executed shuffled-state (shuffle url_after within sessions, N=1999, recompute encoding and ACF) and used it as C1 test. Shuffled-action would leave state ACF unchanged (degenerate), so deviation is substantively correct for state-ACF hypothesis, but spec fidelity fails. Shuffled-state null mean -0.0335, std 0.104, 95th 0.138, 99th 0.204; observed 0.418-0.454 exceeds 99th (p_raw 0.0005, p_bonf 0.0025) on 5/5 variants.

Observed lag1 0.418-0.454 exceeds 99th (0.203-0.225). Indicates ACF not driven by marginal state frequencies/self-loops alone but by temporal order. Pass as discriminating baseline.

baseline_findings.expected: First-order Markov surrogate: fit transition matrix, generate synthetic sequences preserving session structure (N=500), compute ACF. If empirical matches surrogate, first-order explains structure.
baseline_findings.observed: Executed (N=500). Surrogate lag1 mean 0.340-0.352, std 0.11-0.12, 95th 0.528-0.556. Observed 0.418 (4-state) and 0.454 (3-state) fall within surrogate 95% interval, consistent with first-order deterministic FSM (expected for hash-SPA). Baseline correctly indicates no higher-order timescale needed; not evidence for separation.

baseline_findings.observed: Claimed by construction, not empirically simulated in code. Observed ACF 0.418-0.454 >>0 confirms temporal structure beyond stationary sampling. Baseline is tautological but informative as memoryless floor.

baseline_findings.expected: Random walk on state graph: lag1 ACF ~1/n_states, uniform decay, no non-uniform timescale.
baseline_findings.observed: NOT executed as isolated random walk. Producer infers null behavior from shuffled-state mean -0.034 (close to 0) and reports pass true. For n=3-4 states, expected 1/n=0.25-0.33 but observed shuffled-state ~0 indicates encoding and session shuffling suppresses revisit bias. Control is approximated, not directly tested.

claim_ceiling: MAX JUSTIFIED: TodoMVC hash-SPA NL state sequences (80 NL transitions/variant, 6 sessions, 3-4 URL+hash states, determinism 0.925-1.0) exhibit significant lag-1 autocorrelation on temporal-order integer encoding (ACF 0.418 for 4-state {vanillajs,react,svelte}, 0.454 for 3-state {vue,angular}, shuffled-state null mean -0.034, p_raw=0.0005, p_bonf=0.0025) detectable by within-session permutation test. ACF decays after lag1 and lies within first-order Markov surrogate range (mean 0.349, 95th 0.547), consistent with deterministic FSM cycle. No evidence for distinct operational timescales: inter-event times are unimodal (mean 1.12s, median 0.91s, range 0.71-1.84, uniform Playwright pacing) and FSM-type × lag interaction is null (p=0.97). The lag-1 signal is attributable to scripted 7-step automation cycle, not natural Web dynamics. BOUNDED TO scripted hash-SPAs at this scale; does not demonstrate timescale separation, beyond-memory predictive structure, or general Web dynamical structure. NOT established: page-load vs session vs site timescales, production SPAs, stochastic transitions, titles, DOM/network representations, or any C-WEB-DYNAMICS beyond this on-site scripted autocorrelation. Pipeline not validated for generic timescale detection (positive control fails).
unresolved: Whether lag-1 ACF reflects genuine Web state dynamics or is solely scripted-cycle artifact; requires real user sessions with variable pacing and diverse actions on same SPAs.
Whether ACF at lags 2-6 would become significant with larger N (currently 80 NL, 74 inter-event intervals, lags 2-6 p_raw 0.04-0.97 non-significant).
Whether non-uniform ACF decay would survive a valid ANOVA or spectral estimate with sufficient lag resolution; current p=0.0 claim is not per frozen method.

Whether inter-event times would show multimodality on human-paced or heavy-tail production site; current dip p=1.0 is invalid implementation and environment has no operational timescale variation by design.

Whether 4-state vs 3-state FSM difference (0.418 vs 0.454, diff -0.036 at lag1) would become significant with more independent sessions or richer encodings; current p=0.97 based on 2 FSM types × 5 variants.

Positive control redesign: what synthetic SPA parameterization (biased transition matrix, monotonic state encoding, or alternative metric such as transition-count BF/PMI) would validate ACF pipeline for timescale detection.

Generalization of lag-1 finding to production SPAs with client-side state, auth, external data, and to richer representations (DOM, a11y, network) where C-WEB-DYNAMICS beyond-memory structure remains untested (claim_state HYPOTHESIS).
